name: Yuuyake -November-
source:
Main character studies in high school together with four classmates. There are four stories, each with a specific theme:
1. "To the innocent eyes" 「無邪気な瞳に」
2. "Shake feeling" 「揺らぐ想い」
3. "Wipe the wound" 「傷をぬぐうように」
4. "Looking up at the sky" 「空を見上げたら」

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
